# Testing skill: Expense Tracker

Derive pytest cases from `docs/requirements-analysis.md` and `docs/design.md`. Cover add/list/total/filter, category normalization and defaulting, Decimal precision, JSON round-trip across tracker instances, insertion order, missing storage, malformed/structurally invalid records, invalid amounts/descriptions/categories, failed replacement safety, CLI success/error status, and UTF-8. Use temporary paths and keep application tests separate from agent-output evaluations. Run focused tests first, then the full suite.
